title: Lyn Buchanan brought to an underground site with a reconstructed airliner-UFO collision

tellings.quote: they had reconstructed FAA style a collision between an airliner and a UFO

plain: A man named Lyn Buchanan was reportedly taken to a deep underground facility in California where a collision between an airliner and a UFO had been rebuilt piece by piece, the way the FAA, the US agency that oversees air travel, rebuilds crashed planes to study them. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this, passing on what Buchanan said. If true, it would mean a passenger plane once hit an unknown craft and the wreckage was kept secret.
